summary.name: Misskey
summary.one_liner: Misskey is free, open-source software for creating and running your own federated (Fediverse-connected) social networking server.
use_cases: Run a personal social server connected to the Fediverse
Host a community server for users with shared interests
Set up a company promotional account server
Build a private internal company social network
summary.what_it_does: Misskey is server software for building social networking services that implement the ActivityPub protocol, so they can interact with the Fediverse and other ActivityPub software. It includes a web UI with notes, reactions, custom emojis, channels, antennas, roles, polls, drive file management and multi-factor authentication. Moderation tools are built into the web UI. The backend uses Node.js and PostgreSQL, with features such as job queuing via BullMQ, Redis-based timelines, full-text search (PostgreSQL or Meilisearch), and an HTTP API with webhooks and WebSocket support.
notable: Implements ActivityPub for connecting to the Fediverse
Built-in moderation tools and chart engine in the web UI
MFM (Misskey Flavored Markdown) for formatting notes
Web UI is a PWA with plugins written in AiScript
caveats: Misskey is server software, not a ready-made hosted service; operators must install or use managed hosting
Some features such as JWT authentication, a new lighter backend and Vapor mode are listed as coming soon, not yet available
Project is run by volunteers and relies on donations
